_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermo#4 — hand-building a thermal-structural coupling inside PROBLEMTYPE 'Thermo' does not produce a coupled problem, it produces a heat-conduction run with the structural half deleted. A STRUCTURE ELEMENTS block plus MAT_Struct_StVenantKirchhoff is appended to a working thermo deck: the run exits 0, passes its thermal result test, prints 'fill_complete() on discretization thermo' and NEVER prints a structure banner (STRUCT_DISCRETISATION_IN_HANDBUILT=0), with no warning of any kind (IGNORED_BLOCK_WARNINGS=0). The control is upstream tsi_heatflux_monolithic.4C.yaml, which does print 'fill_complete() on discretization structure' — so the banner is a real discriminator and its absence is real evidence. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: stop bolting a structural block onto the Thermo deck. The second arm then carries nothing to be silently dropped, DECK_CARRIES_STRUCTURE_ELEMENTS becomes 0 and the fixture must go red — the observation only means something while the block is present.
